verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect export paths. Resource configurations can be exported to open HCL via Terraform tooling (azure-docs-9), and the CLI and REST APIs allow scripted retrieval with JMESPath-customizable output (azure-gh-2, azure-docs-4, azure-docs-5). Nothing documents bulk export of customer data such as storage, databases or logs in open formats, or a documented exit process. Missing for 10: documented full data export across services, open-format guarantees for stored data, egress or migration-off guidance, account-closure/exit process, independent corroboration of a successful exit.
